name: smwpatches-boss-exgfx
title: Boss ExGFX
description:
This patch allows you to use any ExGFX file you want in a vanilla Mode 7 boss battle without the castle destruction cutscenes getting messed up afterwards. It's not compatible with files 100-FFF, so stick whatever boss GFX you want in 80-FF.

Instructions are included in the .asm file.

Now compatible with Asar & sa-1.
